QuestInfo.name: [Stellar Detectives] Traces of Mana
QuestInfo.0: Examine the next entry in the Old Diary via the Quest Icon! Find out what happened next in the search for Tutu and Nenne.
QuestInfo.1: Collect the Mana Particles Nenne left behind to find your next clue by defeating monsters around your level.
QuestInfo.2: Kanna confirmed that Nenne's residual Mana leads to Perion. It seems the sixth page of the diary was restored.
